sources.title: subhashhhhhh/lumen-faces · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Face detection and recognition for Lumen On-device face grouping for Lumen, a local-first Android gallery: it finds the faces in photos and groups them by person. Lumen downloads these files on request from its Settings; no photo or face ever leaves the phone.
